benchmarks.name: MSA_VALID_ALIGNMENT
benchmarks.description: A multiple sequence alignment result must contain at least 2 aligned sequences.
benchmarks.ground_truth: Biologically meaningful MSAs contain 2+ sequences; a count below 2 indicates a degenerate single-sequence alignment.
benchmarks.citation: Madeira F. et al. Nucleic Acids Res. 2022 (EBI ClustalO/MUSCLE services).

benchmarks.name: MSA_ALIGNMENT_METHOD_RECORDED
benchmarks.description: The alignment result must declare its alignment method (clustalo or muscle).
benchmarks.ground_truth: Reproducibility ledger needs the aligner identity; the pipeline default tool is ClustalO.
benchmarks.citation: Madeira F. et al. Nucleic Acids Res. 2022.
